summary: Olenox Industries Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of 100% of CS Digital Ventures, LLC via an Amended Membership Interest Purchase Agreement dated June 16, 2026. Aggregate consideration includes $30 million upfront, plus additional shares and assumption of liabilities (specific per-share price not stated). Concurrently, the Company entered an Exchange Agreement to convert Series D Preferred Stock into Series E Preferred Stock, cancelling the Series D. The filing does not name a board recommendation or financial advisor. The acquisition closed on the same date, indicating immediate control. The structure involves equity conversion and cash consideration. Watch for post-closing adjustments or shareholder litigation regarding the preferred stock exchange.
